audit_items.proof_trace: BlobsByRoot handler lacks epoch-based deprecation check. BlobsByRange (L1007) checks data_availability_boundary and rejects requests outside retention window, but BlobsByRoot serves any cached blobs regardless of epoch, violating full deprecation after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After blob deprecation epoch, attacker sends BlobsByRoot requests for recently-cached blobs that fall outside min_epoch_data_availability_boundary. Handler serves blobs from early_attester_cache without epoch validation, violating spec-mandated deprecation and causing protocol inconsistency with data column transition.
